FUTURES UNITS, MEASURED 2026-09-07 from fixtures/board-sweep/cashbidssingle-hillsdaleelevatorcom.html: this board writes its futures column in DOLLARS per bushel to four places (e.g. "5.3675s"), not in cents or eighths of a cent the way bigriverbids.com writes "459-4". CASH ROUNDING, MEASURED 2026-09-07 across 216 testable rows on the eleven captured dollars-quoting cashbidssingle boards: residuals -0.50 (7), -0.25 (21), 0 (16), +0.25 (140), +0.50 (28), +0.75 (1) and nothing else except Berthold's per-tonne canola. This board posts cash and basis to two decimals and its quote on the quarter-cent grid, so the derived value is a whole number of cents and the quote is not. round-cent-both bounds that at strictly under a cent, which is what two cent-rounded columns can produce between them.
